column3: n. 失泽, 失泽膜, 污点;vt. 使失去光泽, 玷污
column5: Salt air can quickly tarnish silver jewelry left on the beach towel.
column6: 盐雾会让遗落在沙滩巾上的银饰迅速失去光泽。

column3: n. 格言, 座右铭;格言, 准则, 原则
column5: Her favorite maxim is that practice makes perfect in every craft.
column6: 她最喜欢的格言是无论什么技艺都能熟能生巧。

column3: n. 寓言
column5: The novel works as an allegory of revolution and its broken promises.
column6: 这部小说可以看作一部关于革命及其失信的寓言。

column3: vt. 过大而不适于, 长得比...高(或大、快), 成长得不再具有...
column5: Children outgrow shoes so quickly that parents must buy new pairs each season.
column6: 孩子们长个儿太快,父母每个季节都得买新鞋。

column3: n. 礼貌, 规矩, 适当;专有权
column5: Questions of propriety surrounded the mayor's acceptance of such a lavish gift.
column6: 市长收受如此奢华的礼物,引发了是否得体的质疑。

column3: n. 苦恼, 折磨, 苦恼的事由
column5: Modern medicine has turned a once-deadly affliction into a manageable condition.
column6: 现代医学已把一种曾经致命的顽疾变为可控的疾病。

column3: a. 不结果的, 不长果实的, 无子的
column5: After a fruitless search for the keys, she called a locksmith for help.
column6: 找钥匙无果之后,她打电话请锁匠帮忙。

column3: n. 雕刻匠, 雕工, 切肉刀;雕刻器
column5: A skilled carver turned the block of walnut into a graceful swan.
column6: 熟练的雕刻匠把胡桃木块雕成一只优雅的天鹅。

column3: vt. 连根拔起, 根除
column5: The violent storm managed to uproot several century-old trees along the avenue.
column6: 暴风雨把林荫道上几棵百年老树连根拔起。

column3: vt. 泄露, 透露
column5: The company refused to divulge details of the merger before the official announcement.
column6: 公司拒绝在官方公告之前透露合并的细节。

column3: a. 使耗尽的, 使人筋疲力尽的;经验, 技巧, 穷举, 耗尽, 排气
column5: The exhausting hike to the summit took nearly eleven hours in the heat.
column6: 酷热中登顶的徒步近十一个小时,令人筋疲力尽。

column3: vi. 侵犯, 侵蚀, 蚕食;侵犯, 侵入, 侵占
column5: New housing developments steadily encroach on the wetlands that birds depend upon.
column6: 新的住宅开发不断蚕食鸟类赖以生存的湿地。

column3: n. 音乐剧, 传奇剧, 戏剧似的事件
column5: What began as a simple disagreement turned into an office melodrama by Friday.
column6: 一场简单的分歧到周五竟演变成办公室的闹剧。

column3: a. 无道德原则的, 不审慎的, 肆无忌惮的
column5: Unscrupulous dealers sold forged paintings to collectors who never suspected a thing.
column6: 无良商人把赝品画作卖给毫无戒心的收藏家。

column3: a. 有波浪的, 多浪的, 波浪状的, 波动的, 不稳定的
column5: The artist painted wavy lines to suggest wind moving across the wheat field.
column6: 画家用波浪状的线条表现风吹过麦田。

column3: vt. 围攻, 包围
column5: Reporters would besiege the celebrity whenever she appeared in public with her family.
column6: 每当这位名人携家人公开露面,记者都会团团围住她。

column3: vt. 混合, 使微醉, 使咬字不清晰;vi. 胡乱对付
column5: Too many last-minute changes will muddle the schedule and confuse the staff.
column6: 过多的临时变动会搞乱日程,让员工困惑。

column3: vt. 刺绣, 镶边, 装饰;vi. 绣花
column5: My grandmother would embroider delicate flowers on the corners of linen tablecloths.
column6: 祖母常在亚麻桌布的角上绣上精美的花朵。

column3: n. 远见, 深谋远虑;先见, 预见, 预见的能力
column5: Their foresight in building the reservoir saved the city during the long drought.
column6: 他们在修建水库上的远见使城市安然度过漫长的干旱。

column3: n. 辛苦, 苦心, 工夫;a. 辛苦的, 勤勉的, 小心的
column5: Restoring the fresco required painstaking work by a team of patient experts.
column6: 修复壁画需要一组耐心的专家进行艰苦细致的工作。

column3: a. 可容忍的, 可以的
column5: Summer heat in the coastal town is tolerable thanks to constant sea breezes.
column6: 常年不断的海风让海滨小镇的夏日暑热尚可忍受。

column3: adv. 公正地, 理由充分地, 正当地
column5: The court justly awarded compensation to the workers who had been underpaid.
column6: 法院公正地裁定向受欠薪的工人发放补偿。

column3: a. 不屈曲的, 不屈挠的, 顽固的
column5: The manager's inflexible schedule left no room for family emergencies.
column6: 经理僵硬的时间安排完全没有为家庭急事留出余地。

column3: vt. 刺穿, 使呆住, 使固定;贯穿, 刺通
column5: Crowds stood transfixed as the solar eclipse darkened the afternoon sky.
column6: 日食使午后天空变暗时,人群驻足凝望,看得入了迷。

column3: a. 田园诗的, 牧歌的, 悠闲的
column5: They spent an idyllic summer in a cottage beside the quiet lake.
column6: 他们在宁静的湖边小屋度过了一个田园诗般的夏天。

column3: n. 惊愕, 恐怖, 惊惶失措
column5: To the consternation of shareholders, the quarterly report revealed heavy losses.
column6: 季度报告披露巨额亏损,令股东大为惊愕。

column3: n. 背叛, 缺乏, 毛病;缺点, 过失, 背叛
column5: The party suffered a major defection when its finance spokesperson joined the opposition.
column6: 该党遭遇重大倒戈,财政发言人转投了反对党。

column3: n. 不信任, 疑惑;v. 不信任, 疑惑
column5: Years of broken promises deepened the mistrust between the two neighboring states.
column6: 多年的失信加深了两个邻国之间的不信任。

column3: vt. 嘲笑, 愚弄;vi. 表示轻蔑
column5: Some drivers still flout the new speed limits despite heavier fines.
column6: 尽管罚款加重,一些司机仍然无视新的限速规定。

column3: a. 触觉的, 有触觉的;触觉的
column5: The museum offers tactile exhibits so blind visitors can experience the sculptures.
column6: 博物馆提供可触摸展品,让视障观众也能感受雕塑。
